notes.title: BIONICS: We Will Evolve - DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re super excited to announce that the demo for Bionics – We Will Evolve is officially live!

We are Tylobix, an indie game team from Germany, and this is our first major step in bringing Bionics to life. After a lot of love, late nights, and playtesting, we’re proud to finally let you explore the world we’ve started to build.

The demo gives you a first glimpse into what we’re creating – and we’d be absolutely thrilled if you give it a try.
If you find any bugs, weird behavior, or if something just doesn’t feel right – let us know! Your feedback is incredibly valuable and helps us shape the game into something truly great.

We’re now moving forward with developing Chapters 1 to 5… well, that’s the plan anyway! 😄
Our goal is to deliver a story-rich, immersive experience with deep mechanics and a world worth getting lost in.

There’s a lot more to come – new environments, challenging encounters, evolving gameplay, and maybe even a few surprises. So keep an eye out, follow us, and stay tuned for updates.

Thanks so much for being here at the beginning of our journey.
Let’s evolve together!

– Team Tylobix
